policy: The first occurrence keeps the original public slot; all competing content is retained verbatim as structured lesson fields for review.

lessons.title: Data Science Foundations
lessons.content: Data science extracts insight and predictions from data using statistics, programming, and domain knowledge. KEY CONCEPTS: The data science lifecycle — collect, clean, explore, model, communicate. Structured vs unstructured data. Correlation vs causation. WORKED EXAMPLE: Analyzing sales data to find which factors predict churn. PRACTICE: 1) List the lifecycle stages. 2) Give an example of correlation that isn't causation. 3) Classify 3 data types.

lessons.title: Statistics & Probability
lessons.content: Statistics is the backbone of data science. KEY CONCEPTS: Mean/median/mode, variance/standard deviation, distributions (normal, skewed), probability, sampling, hypothesis testing, p-values, confidence intervals. WORKED EXAMPLE: An A/B test uses hypothesis testing to decide if a change truly improved conversion. PRACTICE: 1) Explain standard deviation. 2) Define a p-value. 3) Describe sampling bias.
